# Kashiwaya Inn (柏屋)

> A 140-year-old kominka (traditional Japanese house) guesthouse in Midono-juku,
> the 41st post town on the Nakasendo trail — in Nagiso, Kiso Valley, Nagano,
> Japan, near Tsumago and Magome. Built in 1885 in the style of a honjin
> (samurai inn) and still lived in today.

Official site: https://kashiwaya-inn.com/ (English) · https://kashiwaya-inn.com/ja (日本語)

## Key facts

- Location: Nagiso 3993, Nagiso-machi, Kiso District, Nagano, Japan (Midono-juku)
- Access: 15 minutes on foot from Nagiso Station (JR Chuo line). Free pick-up
  from Nagiso Station, Tsumago and Junikane Station between 16:00–18:00,
  arranged in advance.
- Check-in: 16:00–18:00 (early luggage drop OK; late check-in via WhatsApp)
- Check-out: by 10:00, no procedure
- Rooms: 2 (Japanese-Style Room on the historic 1st floor; Superior Family
  Room on the modern 2nd floor). Booked via the official site.
- Contact: WhatsApp +81 90-3839-2354 · Instagram @kashiwaya_nakasendo
- Wi-Fi: free throughout the house
- Bathrooms: shared shower room, sink and kitchen; private toilets; no bathtub
  (day-trip onsen nearby)
- Laundry: washer-dryer for 1st-floor guests; coin laundry 15 min on foot
- House rules: no pets; no smoking indoors (courtyard OK); quiet after 21:00
- Payments: cards accepted at the inn; local restaurants, buses and trains are
  cash-only (¥1,000 notes recommended); nearest ATM at 7-Eleven (20 min walk)

## Meals (reservation required, up to 3 days before the stay)

- Dinner sets serve 2 people: chicken hot pot ¥6,000 · pork shabu-shabu ¥8,000 ·
  wagyu sukiyaki ¥9,000 · wagyu BBQ ¥10,000 · vegan sets ¥9,000
- Solo travellers: one set per day at half the two-person price
- Breakfast: ochazuke set (vegan & gluten-free) ¥3,000
- Dietary needs (vegan, gluten-free, etc.) accommodated on request
- Cancellation: free until 4 days before the stay; non-refundable from 3 days before
- Exclusive drinks: three craft beers brewed only for Kashiwaya, plus local
  sake and wine

## E-bikes (rental)

- Guided e-bike tours and rentals by Beyond Nakasendo Cycling — https://kiso-ebike-lp.vercel.app/
- Daytime rental (10:00–15:00): ¥4,000 per bike per day
- One-way rental with drop-off at Nagiso or Nojiri Station possible

## Area

- Nakasendo highlights: Magome Pass walk between Magome and Tsumago (easy,
  sneakers fine; bear bells installed on trail), Yogawa Road to Nojiri
- Gorges: Kakizore Gorge ("Kakizore green") and Atera Valley ("Atera blue")
- Luggage forwarding: no-reservation shuttles Magome–Tsumago and Nagiso–Nojiri;
  NLTS and Walk Lite for the wider Kiso area

## Guides

- Tsumago–Magome day walk: https://kashiwaya-inn.com/guide/tsumago-magome-day-walk
- Rainy days in the Kiso: https://kashiwaya-inn.com/guide/rainy-day-in-kiso
- Gorges & rivers by e-bike: https://kashiwaya-inn.com/guide/kiso-valley-ebike-day
